text:
zoe: I opened PR to add a 'Migration checklist for on-prem customers' into Private/VPC install docs. Main goals: document kube-proxy vs iptables/nft differences, include HSM PKCS#11 warmup tips, and an SDK quickstart for environments behind an egress proxy. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4635 - PTAL.

rahul: Thanks. For kube-proxy note: call out that some managed distros run kube-proxy in IPVS mode which affects conntrack expectations; recommend verifying kube-proxy mode with `kubectl -n kube-system get ds kube-proxy -o yaml | grep mode` and include a short remediation: `--conntrack-max-per-core` bump and `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144`.

mei: Adding HSM note: some appliances require a 10s probe delay after the pkcs11 daemon starts. Suggest a systemd snippet: `ExecStartPost=/bin/sh -c 'sleep 10; /usr/local/bin/pkcs11-healthcheck || exit 1'` and recommend `Restart=on-failure` with `RestartSec=5`. Also included `pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so --list-slots` as debug command.

tim: I contributed a tiny Python SDK example for chained egress proxies and a curl fallback for operators: 

```python
# python requests example with proxies chaining
import requests
session = requests.Session()
session.proxies = {
  'http': 'http://corp-proxy.corp:8080',
  'https': 'http://egress.internal:3128'
}
resp = session.get('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health', headers={'Authorization':'Bearer <KEY>'}, timeout=5)
print(resp.status_code, resp.text)
```

tim: For the curl operator example I added: `curl -x http://corp-proxy.corp:8080 -U user:pass -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` and a note about testing MTLS to the egress: `curl --cert client.crt --key client.key https://egress.internal/`

zoe: Good additions. Two editorial points: 1) update internal runbook link under "Secrets rotation" to `/docs/runbooks/secrets-rotation.md` (the old path 404s), 2) include an offline sha256 manifest example for airgap bundles and `sha256sum -c manifest.sha256` verify step.

rahul: LGTM. Left a small nit to clarify that conntrack change may need kubelet restart on older kernels.

mei: CI looks happy. docs-bot: PR 4635 preview deployed (:white_check_mark:)

zoe: I'll address nits and merge after a quick editorial pass. Planning to cut a docs patch tonight. Thanks all. :shipit:
